description: One lead of a campaign: the lead as list_campaign_leads shows it, the mailbox it hears from (`mailbox`, null before its first email), what the campaign does with it next (`next`), and each step in order with its latest email to this lead (`send`) and what came back about that email (`answers`: a reply, a bounce, a spam complaint). `next.state` is `due` (a step may go now, within the campaign's hours and limits), `waits` or `ended`. `waits.why`: `step_on_its_way` (an email is on its way), `step_wait` (the step's days after the one before), `entry_delay` (the wait after a lead is added), `away` (an away message; see `heldUntil`), `held` (paused by a person; see `heldByHand`), `new_leads_cap` (today's first emails are used up), `address_check` (its address waits for a check, or for the campaign to allow a risky or couldn't-tell address, unless a person sent the lead anyway: see `sendAnyway` on the lead) or `mailbox_busy` (its mailbox can't send now). `until` says when, or is null when something else has to change first. `ended.why`: `sequence_done`, `replied` (the campaign stops on a reply), `replied_elsewhere` (the person answered another campaign of the workspace while `replyStopsAllCampaigns` was on; `repliedElsewhere` on the lead names it), `suppressed`, `invalid` or `failed` (its step couldn't be sent, so the lead stopped). A contact that isn't a lead of this campaign answers 404.
name: get_campaign_lead
title: Get a lead
